title: C5 Finding
description: Actionable non-pass discrepancy, anomaly indicator, or verification exception requiring human officer review (Guide §1.3, §3.4 C5, §12.2).

id.description: Unique identifier for this finding instance

rule_id.description: Rule or detector code that triggered the finding

status.description: Rule-result status. Distinct from finding lifecycle.

severity.description: Advisory risk tier. High severity requires mandatory reason for dismissal.

lifecycle.description: Officer review lifecycle state for this finding

reason.description: Plain language reason for this finding

evidence.description: Evidence supporting the finding. Comparison findings MUST present both sides' values and their respective source/provenance (e.g. submitted vs compared_with, or left vs right) and label any simulated source explicitly.

advisory.description: Preliminary indicator requiring human verification; not proof of misconduct

dismissal_reason.description: Mandatory explanation if an officer dismisses a high-severity finding
